description: This Java class defines a handler (PersonUnvoidHandler) that unsets 'voided' status attributes on Person objects in the OpenMRS system when an unvoid operation is performed. It implements the UnvoidHandler interface and is annotated as a Handler supporting Person class.

classes.name: PersonUnvoidHandler
classes.description: A handler class that unsets voided attributes on Person objects within the OpenMRS platform when unvoid action is invoked.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Unsets the 'voided' attributes on a Person object if certain conditions are met, specifically if the person is currently voided and the voiding date matches the original parent voided date.
